questions.stem: What role do decomposers play in the carbon cycle?

options.text: They convert carbon dioxide into oxygen
They break down dead organisms, releasing carbon dioxide through respiration
They absorb carbon dioxide from the air
They store carbon in fossil fuels

questions.explanation: Decomposers (bacteria and fungi) break down dead organisms and waste. As they respire, they release carbon dioxide back into the atmosphere, completing part of the carbon cycle.
